te: Sergei Kirov is assassinated, paving way for the repressive Great Purge, and Vinnytsia massacre by General Secretary of…
dz: 谢尔盖·基洛夫被刺杀,为镇压性大清洗和被苏联共产党总书记约瑟夫·斯大林屠杀的维尼特西亚铺平了道路.
de: Sergei Kirov is assassinated, paving way for the repressive Great Purge, and Vinnytsia massacre by General Secretary of the Communist Party of the Soviet Union, Joseph Stalin.

t: 意大利军队出击阿比西尼亚的沃尔瓦,耗时四天攻克该城.
te: Italian troops attack Wal Wal in Abyssinia, taking four days to capture the city.
dz: 阿比西尼亚危机:意大利军队出击阿比西尼亚的沃尔瓦,耗时四天攻克该城.
de: Abyssinia Crisis: Italian troops attack Wal Wal in Abyssinia, taking four days to capture the city.

t: 匿名酗酒者联合创始人比尔·威尔逊(英语:Bill Wilson (film))饮用他最后一杯酒…
te: Bill Wilson, co-founder of Alcoholics Anonymous, takes his last drink and enters treatment for the final time.
dz: 匿名酗酒者联合创始人比尔·威尔逊(英语:Bill Wilson (film))饮用他最后一杯酒并进入最后一次治疗.
de: Bill Wilson, co-founder of Alcoholics Anonymous, takes his last drink and enters treatment for the final time.

t: 基杰中尉,谢尔盖·普罗克菲耶夫最出名的作品之一,首映.
te: Lieutenant Kijé, one of Sergei Prokofiev's best-known works, premiered.
dz: 基杰中尉,谢尔盖·普罗克菲耶夫最出名的作品之一,首映.
de: Lieutenant Kijé, one of Sergei Prokofiev's best-known works, premiered.

t: 日本放弃了1922年"华盛顿海军条约"和1930年"伦敦海军条约".
te: Japan renounces the Washington Naval Treaty of 1922 and the London Naval Treaty of 1930.
dz: 日本放弃了1922年"华盛顿海军条约"和1930年"伦敦海军条约".
de: Japan renounces the Washington Naval Treaty of 1922 and the London Naval Treaty of 1930.
